title: heygen-com/hyperframes
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】的中文翻译：HeyGen HyperFrames

paragraphs.en: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
paragraphs.zh: 编写 HTML。渲染视频。为智能体而生。

paragraphs.en: Studio | Quickstart | Showcase | Playground | Catalog | Docs | Discord
paragraphs.zh: 工作室 | 快速入门 | 展示 | 演练场 | 目录 | 文档 | Discord

paragraphs.en: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
paragraphs.zh: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可寻址动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。 你可以在本地通过 CLI 使用它，让具备技能的 AI 智能体调用它，或将其作为托管创作工作流背后的渲染核心。

sents.en: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos.
sents.zh: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可寻址动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。

sents.en: Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
sents.zh: 你可以在本地通过 CLI 使用它，让具备技能的 AI 智能体调用它，或将其作为托管创作工作流背后的渲染核心。

paragraphs.en: Using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent? Run npx hyperframes skills update once, then ask your agent to make a video.
paragraphs.zh: 你在使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或其他编程智能体吗？ 运行一次 npx hyperframes skills update，然后让你的智能体制作一段视频。

sents.en: Using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent?
sents.zh: 你在使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或其他编程智能体吗？

sents.en: Run npx hyperframes skills update once, then ask your agent to make a video.
sents.zh: 运行一次 npx hyperframes skills update，然后让你的智能体制作一段视频。

paragraphs.en: For Claude Code, install the versioned plugin:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Claude Code，请安装带版本号的插件：

paragraphs.en: claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes To enable auto-update for the hyperframes marketplace, run claude in a terminal in your project. In Claude Code's terminal UI, run /plugin , then select Marketplaces → hyperframes → Enable auto-update . Afterward, use /hyperframes:hyperframes . See the plugin guide for Copilot, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, updates, and migration.
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes 若要为 hyperframes 市场启用自动更新，请在你的项目中于终端运行 claude。 在 Claude Code 的终端界面中运行 /plugin ，然后选择 Marketplaces → hyperframes → Enable auto-update 。 之后，使用 /hyperframes:hyperframes 。 参阅面向 Copilot、VS Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 的插件指南，以及更新与迁移说明。

sents.en: In Claude Code's terminal UI, run /plugin , then select Marketplaces → hyperframes → Enable auto-update .
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code 的终端界面中运行 /plugin ，然后选择 Marketplaces → hyperframes → Enable auto-update 。

paragraphs.en: For standalone skills (including OpenCode), use:
paragraphs.zh: 对于独立技能（包括 OpenCode），请使用：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes The picker opens with nothing pre-selected — the Core Skills group is all you need; /slideshow , /remotion-to-hyperframes and /figma install on demand. Agents and non-interactive runs should use npx hyperframes skills update instead — it installs exactly the core set, whereas skills add --all installs all 7 published skills. The six repo-internal skills under .claude/skills / .agents/skills are excluded by default. For the full published set use npx hyperframes skills .
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes 选择器打开时没有任何预选——核心技能组就是你所需的全部；/slideshow、/remotion-to-hyperframes 和 /figma 会按需安装。 智能体和非交互式运行应改用 npx hyperframes skills update——它只安装确切的核心技能集，而 skills add --all 会安装全部 7 个已发布的技能。 .claude/skills 和 .agents/skills 下的六个仓库内部技能默认被排除。 如需完整的已发布技能集，请使用 npx hyperframes skills。

paragraphs.en: skills add resolves the skills.sh registry blob, which can lag main by hours. npx hyperframes skills update installs from the current main , so reach for it when you need the newest copy of a skill.
paragraphs.zh: skills add 解析的是 skills.sh 注册表的 blob，可能滞后于 main 分支数小时。npx hyperframes skills update 则从当前的 main 分支安装，因此当你需要某个技能的最新版本时，请使用该命令。

paragraphs.en: Run project-local installs from your video project's directory. From a HyperFrames checkout, use npx hyperframes skills update for a global install instead: a project-local installer target can overlap the tracked skills/ source and overwrite uncommitted edits. See contributor setup .
paragraphs.zh: 从视频项目的目录运行项目级本地安装。 如果使用 HyperFrames 的检出副本，请改用 npx hyperframes skills update 进行全局安装：项目级本地安装的目标可能会与被跟踪的 skills/ 源目录重叠，并覆盖未提交的修改。请参见贡献者环境搭建。

paragraphs.en: Using /hyperframes , create a 10-second product intro with a fade-in title, a background video, and subtle background music.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 /hyperframes，创建一个 10 秒的产品介绍视频，包含淡入标题、背景视频和轻柔的背景音乐。

paragraphs.en: The skills teach agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render. They work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, IBM Bob, and other coding agents that support skills.
paragraphs.zh: 这些技能教会智能体 HyperFrames 的制作流程：规划视频、编写有效的 HTML、接入可跳转的动画、添加媒体、进行 lint 检查、预览以及渲染。 它们可与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、IBM Bob 以及其他支持技能的编码智能体配合使用。

sents.en: The skills teach agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render.
sents.zh: 这些技能教会智能体 HyperFrames 的制作流程：规划视频、编写有效的 HTML、接入可跳转的动画、添加媒体、进行 lint 检查、预览以及渲染。

sents.en: They work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, IBM Bob, and other coding agents that support skills.
sents.zh: 它们可与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、IBM Bob 以及其他支持技能的编码智能体配合使用。

paragraphs.en: HyperFrames ships 7 skills. Make any video by asking for it; the /hyperframes skill carries the contract and the references (film, captions, overlays, motion, look). Read it first.
paragraphs.zh: HyperFrames 自带 7 个技能。 只需提出要求即可制作任意视频；/hyperframes 技能承载了契约与参考内容（影片、字幕、叠加层、动效、视觉风格）。请先阅读它。

sents.en: Make any video by asking for it; the /hyperframes skill carries the contract and the references (film, captions, overlays, motion, look). Read it first.
sents.zh: 只需提出要求即可制作任意视频；/hyperframes 技能承载了契约与参考内容（影片、字幕、叠加层、动效、视觉风格）。请先阅读它。

paragraphs.en: For standalone installation, default to the core set ( /hyperframes , /hyperframes-cli , /hyperframes-registry , /media-use ). npx hyperframes skills update installs exactly that from anywhere; the interactive picker ( npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes ) lists it as the "Core Skills" group, nothing pre-selected. The picker is interactive-only — a non-interactive or agent run without --skill installs all 7. Use npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --all to install the complete published set deliberately (skips the picker), or npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill <name> for just one (bare name, no leading / ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于独立安装，默认为核心集（ /hyperframes 、 /hyperframes-cli 、 /hyperframes-registry 、 /media-use ）。npx hyperframes skills update 在任何位置都会精确安装这套内容；交互式选择器（ npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes ）将其列为 "Core Skills" 组，且不预选任何项。 该选择器仅支持交互式使用——不带 --skill 的非交互运行或智能体运行会安装全部 7 个。 使用 npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --all 可以刻意安装完整的已发布集合（跳过选择器），或使用 npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill <name> 仅安装一个（使用裸名称，不带前导 / ）。

paragraphs.en: Standalone installs stay lean after that: npx hyperframes init installs the core set only when it is missing and never touches a skill you already have ( npx hyperframes skills update refreshes them, and never removes one); /figma , /slideshow and /remotion-to-hyperframes install on demand with npx hyperframes skills update <name> . Nothing re-pulls the full set behind your back.
paragraphs.zh: 此后独立安装保持精简：npx hyperframes init 仅在核心技能集缺失时才安装它，并且绝不会改动你已有的技能（npx hyperframes skills update 会刷新它们，且不会移除任何技能）；/figma、/slideshow 和 /remotion-to-hyperframes 可按需通过 npx hyperframes skills update <name> 安装。 不会有任何操作在你不知情的情况下重新拉取完整技能集。

paragraphs.en: Plugins bundle the full skill catalog and use their agent's update manager. bun run package:agent-plugin builds the committed portable ZIP, source metadata, and SHA-256 checksum. See the maintainer checklist .
paragraphs.zh: 插件捆绑完整的技能目录，并使用其智能体的更新管理器。bun run package:agent-plugin 会构建已提交的可移植 ZIP、源元数据和 SHA-256 校验和。 参见维护者清单。

paragraphs.en: Build the upload-ready Codex plugin archive from the committed HEAD version of the manifest, brand assets, and skills:
paragraphs.zh: 从已提交的 HEAD 版本中的清单、品牌资产和技能构建可上传的 Codex 插件归档：

paragraphs.en: bun run package:codex-plugin This writes dist/hyperframes-plugin.zip with a hyperframes/ root folder and fails if the archive exceeds Codex's 100 MB upload limit.
paragraphs.zh: bun run package:codex-plugin 该命令会生成 dist/hyperframes-plugin.zip，其中包含一个 hyperframes/ 根文件夹；如果压缩包超过 Codex 的 100 MB 上传限制，则会失败。

paragraphs.en: For visual design handoff workflows, see the Claude Design guide and Open Design guide .
paragraphs.zh: 关于视觉设计交接工作流，请参阅 Claude Design 指南和 Open Design 指南。

paragraphs.en: npx hyperframes init my-video cd my-video npx hyperframes preview # preview in browser with live reload npx hyperframes render # render to MP4 Requirements: Node.js 22+, FFmpeg
paragraphs.zh: npx hyperframes init my-video cd my-video npx hyperframes preview # 在浏览器中预览并支持实时刷新 npx hyperframes render # 渲染为 MP4 要求：Node.js 22+、FFmpeg

paragraphs.zh: 需要灵感？ 浏览展示区（Showcase），观看、阅读、运行并再创作那些已完成的视频。

paragraphs.en: frame.md — your design system, ready for video.
paragraphs.zh: frame.md —— 你的设计系统，已为视频准备就绪。

paragraphs.en: Every brand has a design.md . None of them were written for a camera. frame.md is the missing translation layer: it takes your web-context design spec and inverts it for the frame — the same tokens, the same rules, but rewritten so an AI agent can compose a promo video without guessing at scale or reaching for web chrome.
paragraphs.zh: 每个品牌都有一份 design.md。 但没有一份是为镜头（camera）而写的。frame.md 就是缺失的翻译层：它接收你的网页语境设计规范，并将其转换为适配画面（frame）的版本——使用相同的 tokens、相同的规则，但经过重写，让 AI 智能体能够直接创作宣传片，无需猜测尺寸，也不用套用网页装饰元素。

paragraphs.zh: 输出是一个 DESIGN.md 超集，你的整个工具链都能读取。原子保持神圣。组合保持自由。 数字来自脚本。

paragraphs.en: Define a video as HTML. Add data attributes for timing and tracks. Use GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or your own frame adapter for seekable animation.
paragraphs.zh: 将视频定义为 HTML。 添加用于计时和轨道的数据属性。 使用 GSAP、CSS、Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、WAAPI 或你自己的帧适配器来实现可寻址的动画。

sents.en: Define a video as HTML.
sents.zh: 将视频定义为 HTML。

sents.en: Add data attributes for timing and tracks.
sents.zh: 添加用于计时和轨道的数据属性。

sents.en: Use GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or your own frame adapter for seekable animation.
sents.zh: 使用 GSAP、CSS、Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、WAAPI 或你自己的帧适配器来实现可寻址的动画。

sents.en: Render locally or in Docker.
sents.zh: 在本地或 Docker 中渲染。

sents.en: The renderer seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes the result with FFmpeg, so the same input produces the same video.
sents.zh: 渲染器在无头 Chrome 中逐帧定位并使用 FFmpeg 对结果进行编码，因此相同的输入会产生相同的视频。

paragraphs.en: HyperFrames is the open-source rendering engine, plus a growing set of tools around HTML-native video creation.
paragraphs.zh: HyperFrames 是一个开源渲染引擎，外加一套不断增长的围绕 HTML 原生视频创作的工具集。

paragraphs.en: Install ready-to-use blocks and components:
paragraphs.zh: 安装开箱即用的区块和组件：

paragraphs.en: npx hyperframes add flash-through-white # shader transition npx hyperframes add instagram-follow # social overlay npx hyperframes add data-chart # animated chart Browse the catalog at hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog .
paragraphs.zh: npx hyperframes add flash-through-white # 着色器转场 npx hyperframes add instagram-follow # 社交覆盖层 npx hyperframes add data-chart # 动画图表 请在 hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog 浏览目录。

paragraphs.en: HyperFrames is inspired by Remotion . Both tools render video with headless Chrome and FFmpeg. The main difference is the authoring model: Remotion's bet is React components; HyperFrames' bet is plain HTML that humans and agents can both write easily.
paragraphs.zh: HyperFrames 的灵感来源于 Remotion。 这两个工具都使用无头 Chrome 和 FFmpeg 渲染视频。 主要区别在于创作模型：Remotion 押注的是 React 组件；HyperFrames 押注的是普通 HTML，人类和智能体都能轻松编写。

paragraphs.en: HyperFrames is used in production at HeyGen , with community examples from teams like tldraw , TanStack , and others in ADOPTERS.md . Open a PR if your team is using HyperFrames.
paragraphs.zh: HyperFrames 已在 HeyGen 的生产环境中使用，tldraw、TanStack 等团队的社区示例见 ADOPTERS.md。 如果你的团队正在使用 HyperFrames，欢迎提交 PR。

paragraphs.en: The repo uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines under packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 (about 240 MB of .mp4 files). If you're cloning the full repo for development, install Git LFS first:
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库使用 Git LFS 存储 packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 下的黄金回归测试基线（约 240 MB 的 .mp4 文件）。 如果你要克隆完整仓库进行开发，请先安装 Git LFS：

sents.en: The repo uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines under packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 (about 240 MB of .mp4 files).
sents.zh: 该仓库使用 Git LFS 存储 packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 下的黄金回归测试基线（约 240 MB 的 .mp4 文件）。

sents.en: If you're cloning the full repo for development, install Git LFS first:
sents.zh: 如果你要克隆完整仓库进行开发，请先安装 Git LFS：

paragraphs.en: # macOS brew install git-lfs # Ubuntu / Debian sudo apt install git-lfs # Windows winget install GitHub.GitLFS # Then, once per machine git lfs install If you only need source files, you can skip LFS content:
paragraphs.zh: # macOS brew install git-lfs # Ubuntu / Debian sudo apt install git-lfs # Windows winget install GitHub.GitLFS # 然后，每台机器只需执行一次 git lfs install 如果你只需要源代码文件，可以跳过 LFS 内容：

paragraphs.en: GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git License Apache 2.0
paragraphs.zh: GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git 许可证 Apache 2.0
